identity.name: E1
identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King. Zoom In. Negative Space. Contrast.

project_context.description: A high-energy, dashboard-style SaaS for regional outfit transformation. Dark, immersive, and vibrant.
project_context.target_audience: Gen Z, Fashion Enthusiasts, Social Media Creators

layout_strategy.grid_config: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 h-screen overflow-hidden

areas.sidebar: lg:col-span-4 flex flex-col gap-6 overflow-y-auto p-6 bg-[#0E0E10] border-r border-[#27272A]
areas.main_canvas: lg:col-span-8 relative flex items-center justify-center bg-[#030304] p-6

RegionSelector.style: Grid of square cards. Each card has an icon/flag and text. Active state: #DFFF00 border + Glow.
RegionSelector.interaction: Click to select. Smooth scale animation on hover.

StyleSelector.style: Pill-shaped buttons or small cards. Active: Filled #DFFF00 (Text Black). Inactive: Outlined (Text White).

ComparisonSlider.style: Full height image container. Draggable handle in the middle (Neon line).

GenerateButton.style: Full width, h-16, bold text, neon background. Loading state: pulsing gradient or glitch effect.

UploadZone.style: Border-dashed border-2 border-[#27272A] hover:border-[#DFFF00] rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-64 transition-all
UploadZone.content: Drag & Drop or Click. Support: JPG, PNG.

preferences.page_load: Staggered fade-in + slide-up for dashboard panels.
preferences.generation: Scanline effect or Glitch animation during 'Processing'.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for the main background. Use solid #030304 or subtle noise.
Ensure the 'Before' and 'After' images align perfectly for the slider to work.
Input fields should have a distinct focus state (Neon Border).
Avoid 'Inter' font. Use 'Space Grotesk' for body text.
Keep the UI 'App-like' (no scroll on body, scroll inside containers).
instructions_to_main_agent:
1. Install dependencies: `framer-motion`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `lucide-react`, `sonner`. 
2. Configure Tailwind with the provided colors and fonts. 
3. Build the 'Dashboard Layout' first (Sidebar + Main Area). 
4. Implement the 'Upload' and 'Comparison' logic. 
5. Use the provided Unsplash URLs for demo/placeholder states. 
6. Mock the 'Gemini Generation' with a `setTimeout` if the API isn't ready, but structure it for real integration.
